title: RoboMonkey: Scaling Test-Time Sampling and Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
authors_zh: Jacky Kwok、Christopher Agia、Rohan Sinha、Matt Foutter、Shulu Li、Ion Stoica、Azalia Mirhoseini、Marco Pavone
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: RoboMonkey ranks sampled VLA actions with a verifier trained on RMSE-derived preferences.
RoboMonkey 用基于均方根误差偏好训练的验证器，对采样出的视觉语言动作候选排序。（论文未披露的发布、回放与审计细节保留为未知。）
why: It separates action proposal, proxy preference, ranking, and execution trace contracts.
inclusion_reason: Embodied action rollout selection with synthetic verifier-training traces.

title: Problem
问题
html: RoboMonkey studies test-time scaling for vision-language-action policies: a base VLA may assign nonzero probability to a better action than greedy decoding returns, but robot deployment needs an efficient way to generate and rank alternatives. The associated data problem is to construct action preferences from imitation-learning trajectories and preserve the link among observation, instruction, candidate action, expert action, proxy distance, preference, verifier score, and executed choice.
RoboMonkey 研究视觉语言动作策略的测试时扩展：基础 VLA 可能对优于贪心解码结果的动作赋予非零概率，但机器人部署需要高效生成并排序这些备选动作。对应的数据问题是从模仿学习轨迹构造动作偏好，并保留观察、指令、候选动作、专家动作、代理距离、偏好、验证器分数和实际选择之间的关联。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The training pipeline samples actions from a reference VLA at states drawn from expert demonstrations, clusters them into representatives, and labels pairwise preferences by which action has lower RMSE to the recorded expert action. A LLaVA-7B-based verifier learns these comparisons with a margin-augmented Bradley–Terry objective. At deployment, a few VLA samples define Gaussian proposal distributions for translation and rotation, majority voting fixes the gripper bit, and the verifier selects one augmented action for execution.
训练流程在专家示范状态上用参考 VLA 采样动作，将动作聚类为代表项，再根据候选动作与记录中专家动作的 RMSE 大小生成两两偏好。基于 LLaVA-7B 的验证器使用带 margin 的 Bradley–Terry 目标学习这些比较。部署时，少量 VLA 样本用于拟合平移与旋转的高斯提议分布，夹爪位由多数投票确定，验证器从扩增动作中选择一项执行。

title: Method
方法
html:
The primary training source is Bridge V2, reported as more than 40,000 real-world WidowX trajectories from 24 environments. For each instruction–observation–expert-action tuple, a reference policy generates candidate actions; clustering reduces redundancy, and all pairwise comparisons from the same initial condition are grouped for training. The preferred action is the one with lower RMSE to the demonstration action. The paper reports 20 million synthetic comparisons. The 7B verifier replaces LLaVA’s unembedding layer with a reward head and optimizes a Bradley–Terry loss that incorporates the magnitude of the RMSE preference gap.

At every deployment timestep, RoboMonkey draws initial actions from the VLA at positive temperature, majority-votes the discrete gripper command, fits separate Gaussian distributions to translation and rotation, samples augmented candidates, scores them, executes the highest-scored action, and observes the next state. In one real-robot configuration, five initial OpenVLA samples produce 16 candidates; the optimized serving path reports roughly 650 ms for sampling and verification. Candidate counts, temperature, and hardware are configuration-specific rather than fixed properties of the data object.

主要训练来源为 Bridge V2，论文称其包含来自 24 个环境、超过 4 万条 WidowX 真实机器人轨迹。对每个“指令—观察—专家动作”元组，参考策略生成候选动作；聚类减少冗余，同一初始条件下的全部两两比较被分组训练。与示范动作 RMSE 更低的候选被标为偏好项。论文报告共生成 2000 万条合成比较。7B 验证器把 LLaVA 的 unembedding 层替换为 reward head，并使用包含 RMSE 偏好差幅度的 Bradley–Terry 损失。

部署的每个时间步，RoboMonkey 以正温度从 VLA 采样初始动作，对离散夹爪命令做多数投票，分别为平移和旋转拟合高斯分布，再采样扩增候选、评分、执行最高分动作并观察下一状态。一个真实机器人配置以 5 个 OpenVLA 初始样本生成 16 个候选，优化服务路径报告采样加验证约 650 ms。候选数、温度和硬件均是具体配置，而不是数据对象的固定属性。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The PMLR paper establishes the Bridge V2 source, synthetic comparison recipe, 20-million-comparison scale, verifier architecture, preference objective, and test-time proposal procedure. The official project now links a public implementation, a monkey-verifier-7b checkpoint, and an action_preference_bridge dataset. The dataset endpoint reports 22.5 GB but has no dataset card, and the model card is empty; release existence is confirmed, while schema and documentation completeness are not.

Action-error scaling, SIMPLER success, real-robot OOD results, and data-scaling curves evaluate the method. They do not make RMSE a ground-truth measure of task success, safety, or semantic correctness, and they do not validate every synthetic comparison.

PMLR 论文可核实 Bridge V2 来源、合成比较配方、2000 万比较的规模、验证器架构、偏好目标和测试时提议流程。官方项目目前已链接公开实现、monkey-verifier-7b 检查点和 action_preference_bridge 数据。数据端点显示总大小 22.5 GB，但没有 dataset card；模型卡内容为空。因此可以确认工件存在，但不能确认其模式与文档完整性。

动作误差扩展、SIMPLER 成功率、真实机器人 OOD 结果和数据规模曲线评估的是方法。它们不能把 RMSE 变成任务成功、安全或语义正确性的真值，也不能验证每条合成比较。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The main contribution is a scalable, fully synthetic preference contract for robot actions: relative proximity to an expert action supervises a visual-language verifier, which then converts additional test-time samples into a ranked action set. Gaussian augmentation separates proposal scaling from repeated expensive policy decoding. The novelty is bounded by the proxy: the system learns imitation closeness, not a general world-model or certified task-success reward.
主要贡献是一种可扩展、完全合成的机器人动作偏好契约：候选相对专家动作的接近程度监督视觉语言验证器，验证器再把测试时额外采样转为有序动作集合。高斯扩增把提议规模扩展与反复昂贵的策略解码分离。其新颖性受代理指标限制：系统学习的是模仿接近度，不是通用世界模型或经过认证的任务成功奖励。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
RMSE to one recorded expert action is an imitation proxy. Multiple actions may be valid, and a numerically close action may still collide, violate constraints, or fail a long-horizon task. The verifier can inherit bias from the base policy, demonstration distribution, image encoder, action discretization, and correlated synthetic labels. Test-time sampling may also propose unsafe actions before filtering, while the highest verifier score has no formal safety guarantee.

The released preference dataset lacks a dataset card; exact fields, splits, cluster settings, sampling temperatures, rejection policy, source identifiers, seeds, record-level licenses, and decontamination are unknown from the endpoint. The model card is empty. Repository/model licenses do not automatically establish redistribution rights for Bridge V2 derivatives. Benchmark gains and synthetic-data scaling are not record-level quality audits.

相对单个记录专家动作的 RMSE 只是模仿代理。多个动作可能同样有效，而数值上接近的动作仍可能碰撞、违反约束或在长程任务中失败。验证器会继承基础策略、示范分布、图像编码器、动作离散化和相关合成标签的偏差。测试时采样还可能在过滤前产生不安全动作，最高验证器分数也没有形式化安全保证。

公开偏好数据缺少 dataset card；从端点无法确认精确字段、划分、聚类设置、采样温度、拒绝策略、来源 ID、随机种子、逐记录许可证和去污染。模型卡为空。仓库或模型许可证也不自动证明 Bridge V2 衍生数据可再分发。Benchmark 提升和合成数据扩展曲线不是逐记录质量审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: RoboMonkey is useful for designing verifier-training data for embodied action selection. A reusable record should include demonstration and policy revisions, observation frame(s), instruction, expert action, raw candidates, cluster assignment, representative actions, RMSE values, pairwise winner/loser and margin, verifier score, selected action, environment outcome, and safety flags. This schema allows downstream users to replace the RMSE proxy or study disagreement between imitation distance and actual success.
RoboMonkey 适合用于设计具身动作选择的验证器训练数据。可复用记录应包含示范与策略版本、观察帧、指令、专家动作、原始候选、聚类归属、代表动作、RMSE 值、两两胜负及 margin、验证器分数、选中动作、环境结果和安全标记。这样的模式允许下游替换 RMSE 代理，或研究模仿距离与实际成功之间的分歧。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat RMSE preference as proximity to one demonstrated action, not task-success ground truth.
  • Separate the released training comparisons from runtime proposal and execution traces.
  • The paper reports 20 million comparisons; verify the public artifact revision before assuming identical contents.
  • Candidate count and latency numbers are configuration-specific.
  • The current dataset and model endpoints confirm artifacts but provide incomplete documentation.

• 将 RMSE 偏好理解为对单个示范动作的接近度，而不是任务成功真值。
  • 区分已发布的训练比较数据与运行时提议/执行轨迹。
  • 论文报告 2000 万条比较；假定公开工件内容完全一致前应先固定并核验版本。
  • 候选数与延迟数字依赖具体配置。
  • 当前数据和模型端点可确认工件存在，但文档不完整。
